meaning:
ἄμαχος, -ον
(μάχη);
1. invincible (frequently in cl.).
2. abstaining from fighting, non-combatant (Xen.). Metaphorical (cf. MM, VGT, see word), not contentious: 1Ti.3:3, Tit.3:2.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: not a drinker, not violent, not greedy for money, but gentle, not quarrelsome, not covetous;
to speak evil of no one, not to be contentious, to be gentle, showing all humility toward all men.
